images.author: The Paper; photographer uncredited
images.why: 2048×1365 event photograph of founder Yang Zhilin holding a Moonshot-branded microphone. Blue background and seated composition suit a portrait crop with text below.

images.author: Kimberly White / Getty Images for SSI
images.why: 2048×1495 published office portrait from SSI’s August 2025 Palo Alto shoot. Sutskever’s folded-arm pose and subdued background work well for a tight 9:10 crop.

images.author: NVIDIA
images.why: Official partnership photograph of Mira Murati with Jensen Huang in a bright architectural interior. Full-size image endpoint opens directly; crop toward Murati for the portrait card.

images.author: Thinking Machines Lab
images.why: Company-supplied founder portrait accompanying Thinking Machines Lab’s launch. Uncropped 2560-pixel image endpoint; the single-subject composition is especially suitable for 9:10.

images.author: David Paul Morris / Getty Images
images.why: Murati representing Thinking Machines Lab at NVIDIA GTC 2026. Direct 2560-pixel event-photo endpoint provides a current alternative to the launch portrait.
